stories.headline: US-China AI risk dialogue moves forward
stories.summary: Bessent said a bilateral dialogue will address advanced-model testing and serious-incident reporting. Cooperation on risks does not imply agreement on strategic competition or a binding AI-safety framework.

stories.headline: SoftBank reports $7 billion quarterly loss
stories.summary: SoftBank reported a $7 billion quarterly loss, including a $3.7 billion data-centre equipment charge. Financing costs more than doubled; potential future rebates could offset part of the equipment loss.

stories.headline: House blocks Hegseth impeachment effort
stories.summary: House Republicans blocked the effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. The procedural reprieve is not a Senate acquittal or a finding on the allegations; another effort remains possible.

stories.headline: Ukraine peace talks enter a second day
stories.summary: Russian, Ukrainian and US negotiators resumed talks in Abu Dhabi. Officials described constructive discussions, but there is no confirmed breakthrough; territory and security guarantees remain disputed.

stories.headline: Iran nuclear stance clouds de-escalation hopes
stories.summary: Iran's security chief rejected sending enriched material abroad. Oil rose as hopes for rapid de-escalation weakened, while Strait of Hormuz shipping risks persisted. No peace agreement is confirmed.
